scientific_limitations: Only nonalgebraic one-types over the standard-example finite parameters are classified; higher arity is not addressed.
Order duality is an involution on extension diagrams, not a claim of an order-preserving automorphism.
The labelled scalar count follows from existing general height-two one-type counting and is not claimed separately as new.
Equivalent results in unindexed specialist literature cannot be excluded; independent scientific audit is outstanding.
title: Signed symmetry character of one-point types over standard-example posets
